finding: local_event_repository dispatch checks whether the addressed task is local while holding the actual event lock, releases that lock, and only then calls the original legacy writer which reacquires the lock. A private bootstrap can persist the local binding between those two acquisitions. The original save_state methods have no local binding recheck inside their lock, so they can mutate legacy positive state for the now local task without a private local publication scope.
